- Suggested attendees from your side: Eng lead, infra/ops owner, and the SRE who owns the recommender service.
- From our side: Ben (solutions), Marissa (eng lead), and I (sales).

Availability: to make scheduling easier we've opened a few 90-minute windows next week — I listed them below in your local timezone (PDT):
- Tue 2 Mar: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed 3 Mar: 09:00–10:30 or 16:00–17:30
- Thu 4 Mar: 13:00–14:30

If none of those work, feel free to drop a preferred slot via the Calendly link below and we'll lock it. Also attaching a short pre-read with the topics Ben will demo.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/tdx-90min?month=2027-03
